mail.welcome_sub: Sign in to an @%s address or create a new one.
mail.email_hint: Just the username works too - @%s is added for you.
mail.password_hint: Use at least %s characters. Anyone who knows the password can sign in.
mail.username_hint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
mail.name_hint: Shown to people you write to.
mail.cap_signin: You're signed in to as many accounts as allowed. Sign out of one to add another.
mail.cap_create: You've created as many accounts as allowed. Sign in to an existing address instead.
mail.err_fill: Enter your email address and password.
mail.err_username: Usernames are 2-32 characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
mail.err_password: Passwords must be at least %s characters.
mail.confirm_signout_body: %s will be removed from Mail on this computer. Its messages stay in the mailbox - sign back in with the password at any time.
mail.empty_inbox_hint: New messages sent to this address will show up here.
mail.empty_flagged_hint: Flag a message to find it here later.
mail.empty_drafts_hint: Messages you start but don't send are saved here.
mail.empty_sent_hint: Messages you send will show up here.
mail.empty_spam_hint: Mail your phone marks as junk lands here.
mail.empty_bin_hint: Deleted messages stay here until you empty the bin.
mail.confirm_empty_body: Every message in the bin will be deleted for good. You can't undo this.
mail.confirm_delete_body: This message will be deleted for good. You can't undo this.
mail.in_bin_hint: This message is in the bin.
mail.err_too_many: You can send to at most %s recipients.
mail.err_empty: Write a subject or a message first.
mail.sent_partial_title: Some recipients didn't get your message.
mail.sent_failed: These addresses don't exist: %s. A bounce notice is in your inbox.
mail.phone_synced_hint: This is your phone's mail: the same accounts and inbox you see on your phone.
